children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - September 10, 2026) - Lauren Ettin, Chief Executive Officer, Pediatric Oncology Group of Ontario (POGO), and her team joined John McKenzie, Chief Executive Officer, TMX Group, to open the market and celebrate TMX Ring the Bell in support of POGO. This walking, running and cycling charity event raises funds for POGO and its mission.

POGO works to ensure that everyone affected by childhood cancer has access to the best care and support. Their goal is to achieve an excellent childhood cancer care system for children, youth, survivors, and their families and healthcare teams, in Ontario and beyond. POGO champions childhood cancer care, and as the collective voice of this community, is the official advisor to Ontario's Ministry of Health on children's cancer control and treatment.
Head of Media Relations, TMX Group

title: Pediatric Oncology Group of Ontario (POGO) Opens the Market
